judge_reason:
The reviewer's claim is wrong. On page 3 of jahresabschluss_2026.pdf, the 31.12.2025 "V. Jahresüberschuss" is 19.936 TEUR, which matches the 2025 report (page 2: 19.936) and the 2025 income statement (item 17: 19.936). The expected value of 119.936 has no basis. Checks: 2026 Gewinnvortrag 28.289 = 8.353 + 19.936, so the carry-forward ties to the prior-year profit. Equity 31.12.2025 = 100 + 4.290 + 14.048 + 8.353 + 19.936 = 46.727, which matches the 2025 report.

A separate, unraised discrepancy does exist: the 2026 report shows the 31.12.2025 "A. Eigenkapital" as 46.772, but its lines sum to 46.727 (the 2025 report also shows 46.727). This is a 45 TEUR transposition in the comparative total. It is not the issue described, so I did not treat it as the answer, but it should be checked before signing. I did not read the notes for any restatement explaining it.
reason: the judge says invalid, the truth says valid

finding.quote: Die Umsatzerlöse sanken im Geschäftsjahr 2026 um 4,6 % auf 151.420 TEUR (Vorjahr: 158.701 TEUR)
finding.explanation: the text says 158.701, the figures give 258.701 (revenue prior)

judge_reason: Page 8 of jahresabschluss_2026.pdf (Lagebericht, Abschnitt 1 Geschäftsverlauf) reads "sanken ... um 4,6 % auf 151.420 TEUR (Vorjahr: 158.701 TEUR)". The text does say 158.701, not 258.701. The percentage confirms it: 151.420 / 158.701 = 0.9541, a decline of 4.59%, which rounds to 4.6%. With 258.701 the decline would be about 41.5%, so the reviewer's expected value is wrong and the sentence is internally consistent. No correction is needed.
reason: the judge says invalid, the truth says valid
